name: Challenge: Extreme resize values remain bounded and Cancel preserves artwork and Undo
description: Exercise the compiled local PixiBun build through user controls. Use a desktop viewport. Compare actual artwork and persistent state, not only element visibility. Missing prerequisites or unobservable cancellation must be reported rather than silently skipped.

planSteps.description: Verify restoration has finished and the main drawing canvas is editable.
Draw a short horizontal stroke in the upper-left quarter of the drawing canvas, away from its borders.
Draw a separate short vertical stroke in the lower-right quarter of the drawing canvas.
Verify both strokes exist with transparent space between them; remember their positions and shapes for later comparisons.
Open File, then Canvas size… to open Resize Canvas & Frame Bounds.
Verify the displayed width is capped at 512 and the height stays in the supported 4–512 range.
Verify the displayed height is at least 4 and both dimensions remain in the supported range.
Click Cancel in the resize dialog.
Verify the original canvas dimensions, both stroke positions and transparent background remain unchanged.
Verify only the lower-right vertical stroke disappears; the upper-left horizontal stroke remains unchanged.
Verify both strokes exist with transparent space between them; remember their positions and shapes for later comparisons.
